en: Colored illustrated postcard showing a large Alpine hotel complex called Mendelhof with adjoining restaurant and dining hall buildings at Mendel Pass, surrounded by dense coniferous forest and mountains. Early automobiles and carriages stand in front with several people walking around. The image is framed by handwritten cursive text in Italian along the margins and bottom. Printed captions in German at the bottom identify the scene as 'Tirol: Spreter's Mendelhof am Mendelpass b. Bozen' with altitude information and the artist's credit.
